verdict.rationale: logo-design-skill is an Agent Skill: a SKILL.md folder plus local, dependency-free Python tools that an agent loads. It is not a hosted service or API product, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it exposes an HTTP API that such a spec could describe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
